verses.text: For the music director, to the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David, when he fled from Saul into the cave. Have mercy on me, God, have mercy on me. I take refuge in you. I’ll shelter in the shadow of your wings until the disaster passes.
I cry out to God Most High, the God who acts on my behalf.
He’ll send help from heaven and save me. He rebukes the one chasing me. Selah. God will send his faithful love and his truth.
I’m surrounded by lions. I lie among people burning with rage, whose teeth are spears and arrows and whose tongues are sharp swords.
Be exalted above the heavens, God! Let your glory rise above the whole earth!
They set a net in my path, and my soul bowed low. They dug a pit in front of me and fell into it themselves. Selah.
My heart is steady, God. My heart is steady. I’ll sing, yes, I’ll sing praises.
Wake up, my glory! Wake up, lute and harp! I’ll wake the dawn.
I’ll thank you, Lord, among the peoples. I’ll sing praises to you among the nations.
Your great faithful love reaches to the heavens, and your truth reaches to the skies.
Be exalted above the heavens, God. Let your glory be over the whole earth.
